description: Call one read-only JSON-RPC method on an EVM network. Without credentials it uses the public trial endpoint (rate-limited, recent state only); when this MCP connection sends a BlockReq API key or is signed in to a BlockReq account, it uses the caller's own endpoint, metered to their account with their plan's limits and history. eth_getLogs needs numeric fromBlock/toBlock at most 1000 blocks apart, or a blockHash. Responses above 256 KB are refused. It cannot sign or send transactions.

chain.description: Network slug (for example ethereum, base, arbitrum-sepolia), catalog id, hostname, name, or EVM chain ID (1 or 0x1)

params.description: Positional JSON-RPC params; a missing block parameter means latest

name: call_rpc
title: Call a read-only JSON-RPC method
